content_zh:
“虚……”
江枫一滞，怒道：“我何时与移花宫中的妖女虚与委蛇了？！我与月奴我二人倾心相恋，如今月奴更是怀了我的孩子，怎会有什么虚与委蛇一说？”
“公子啊……我都说了，大爷已经到了，您不用再伪装了！”
苏景笑着向江枫走去，说道：“您分明便是被这个妖女给蒙骗了心智，不是您让我叫大爷来救您的吗？至于怀了你的孩子什么的……移花宫中的妖女，私生活不知***到怎样的地步，这孩子怎么可能是您的？还是让开，快让大爷杀了这个妖女为好。”
说着，他上前便要去拉江枫！
“你这混账，给我滚开！”
江枫伸手就去推攘苏景，但苏景伸过来的手也不知怎么的，眼看两只手便要相接，他的手臂却突然诡异的偏了片刻，直接正握住了他的臂膀，江枫那本来用来推攘苏景的手，乍看起来，倒好像是直接伸过去任由苏景扶着他……
花月奴面色顿时大变，眼底浮现惊恐神色，道：“移……移花接玉？！”
枫郎的书童，不过离开了一阵，竟然会使了移花宫最高深的功夫移花接玉，虽然是最为粗浅的低层，但若再加上他刚刚说的话……
花月奴素来聪慧，自然什么都明白了。
她脸色瞬间变的惨白如纸，眼底浮现深切的惊恐神色。
惨笑道：“罢……罢了，我还以为我们已经逃出来了，可没想到，到底还是落入了他们的掌中，枫郎，你跟大哥去吧，有大哥相助，纵然是移花宫，想必也伤不了你了，只要你安全，那么……月奴再没有别的遗憾了，只恨……未能帮你诞下麟儿……”
“哼，都这时候了，你竟然还在作戏？”
这般的态度，却是让燕南天瞬间大怒，喝道：“江琴，你速速将二弟拉开，看我将这贱婢和她腹中的孩子打死，非如此不可泄我心头之恨！！！”
江枫早已经身受重伤，哪里是苏景的对手，直接被他生拖着离了花月奴，苏景不过伸手在他胸口一顶，让他顿时连连咳嗽了几声，要说的话都给咽到了肚子里。
苏景说道：“公子，都这时候了，您何必顾念这贱婢性命？以您的盛世美颜，如果真要在移花宫内发生些什么的话，恐怕也是跟邀月宫主或者怜星吧？结果却是跟个婢女……邀月宫主到底丑成什么样，让您这么不待见她？”
江枫早已经眼呲欲裂，但苏景的手正轻轻的顶压在他的胸口，他每次想要说话，都会感受到一股真气冲撞自己的身体，然后便是一阵不可控制的咳嗽……”
花月奴艰难的站起了身子，声如杜鹃血啼，她悲声对燕南天道：“大哥……我知道，枫郎与我结合，你根本就不相信我，但我求求你，您要杀我不要紧，只盼您让我多活两日，待我为枫郎产下孩儿，到时候……月奴任杀任剐，决无怨言！”
她悲泣道：“在我腹中……那是你的侄儿啊！”
燕南天眉头猛然一阵抖动，喝道：“贱婢，你竟然有脸喊我大哥！当真是好演技，若非江琴告知，我恐怕还真就上了你的恶当，可恨你蛊惑于我那二弟，如今竟然连我也想蛊惑吗？受死！！！”

他怒喝一声，纵身向着花月奴奔去！
“不！！！大哥住手！！！”
江枫声嘶力竭的哭喊，几乎崩溃，有心相助，却被苏景拉着，根本不得上前！
他有心挣脱苏景，但之前受伤太重，再加上苏景这家伙不知从何处学来诡异的手段，竟然把江枫死死的束缚在了原地！
“啊……来了……来了……终于来了……”
远处，邀月眼神之内兴奋神色溢于言表，她猛然一个哆嗦，脸上浮现一抹诡异的嫣红，双~腿不自觉的夹紧……
看着这样的美景即将发生在自己的面前，期待了五天，压抑了五天，在这一刻，她竟然真正的生平第一次，释放了自己！
“受死吧，贱婢！！！”
燕南天怒喝一声，整个人宛若猛虎下山！
举起手掌，向着艰难站起来的花月奴冲去！
“枫郎……最起码，你的性命，算是得以保全了！只恨未能帮你诞下孩儿……”

content_en:
"Xu..."
Jiang Feng hesitated and said angrily: "When did I make a false promise with the enchantress in Yihua Palace?! Yue Nu and I fell in love, and now Yue Nu is pregnant with my child. How can there be any false talk?"
"Sir...I told you, I'm already here, you don't have to pretend anymore!"
Su Jing walked towards Jiang Feng with a smile and said, "You have clearly been deceived by this witch. Didn't you ask me to call the uncle to rescue you? As for being pregnant with your child or something... The witch in Yihua Palace has an unknown private life. How can this child be yours? It's better to get out of the way and let the uncle kill this witch."
With that said, he stepped forward to pull Jiang Feng!
"You bastard, get out of here!"
Jiang Feng stretched out his hand to push Su Jing, but for some reason, Su Jing's extended hand was about to touch. His arm suddenly moved strangely for a moment, and directly held his arm. Jiang Feng's hand that was originally used to push Su Jing, at first glance, seemed to be stretched out directly to let Su Jing support him...
Hua Yuenu's expression suddenly changed, a look of horror appeared in her eyes, and she said: "Move...move the flowers to the jade?!"
Fenglang's book boy, who had only been away for a while, actually mastered the most profound skills of Yihua Palace, although it was the most superficial and low-level, but if you add what he just said...
Huayue Nu has always been smart, so she naturally understands everything.
Her face instantly turned as pale as paper, and a look of deep panic appeared in her eyes.
He smiled miserably and said: "Forget it...forget it, I thought we had escaped, but I didn't expect that we still fell into their hands. Fenglang, you go with your elder brother. With your elder brother's help, even the Yihua Palace will not be able to hurt you. As long as you are safe, then... Yue Nu has no other regrets. I only regret that... I couldn't help you give birth to Lin'er..."
"Hmph, it's already this time and you're still acting?"
Such an attitude made Yan Nantian furious instantly, and shouted: "Jiang Qin, pull your second brother away quickly and watch me beat this wretched maid and the child in her belly to death. You must do this to vent the hatred in my heart!!!"
Jiang Feng had already been seriously injured. He was no match for Su Jing. He was dragged away from Huayue Nu. Su Jing just stretched out his hand and hit his chest, causing him to cough several times and swallow everything he wanted to say.
Su Jing said: "Young Master, it's already this time, why do you care about the life of this cheap maid? With your beauty in this prosperous age, if something really happens in Yihua Palace, it will probably be with Palace Master Yaoyue or Lianxing, right? But it turns out it's with a maid... How ugly is Palace Master Yaoyue so bad that you don't want to see her so much?"
Jiang Feng's eyes were already bursting with tears, but Su Jing's hand was gently pressing on his chest. Every time he wanted to speak, he would feel a burst of true energy rushing into his body, followed by an uncontrollable cough..."
Hua Yuenu stood up with difficulty, her voice was like a cuckoo's cry of blood, and she said sadly to Yan Nantian: "Brother... I know that you don't believe me at all when Feng Lang and I are married, but I beg you, it doesn't matter if you want to kill me, I just hope that you will let me live for two more days, and when I give birth to a child for Feng Lang, then... Yue Nu will be killed and chopped up at will, without any complaints! "
She sobbed: "In my belly...that is your nephew! "
Yan Nantian's brows suddenly trembled, and he shouted: "You bitch, you actually have the nerve to call me big brother! You are really good at acting. If Jiang Qin hadn't told you, I might have fallen into your trap. I hate that you bewitched my second brother, but now you even want to bewitch me? Die! ! ! "
He shouted angrily and ran towards Huayue Nu!
"No! ! ! Brother, stop it! ! ! "
Jiang Feng cried hoarsely and almost collapsed. He wanted to help, but was pulled by Su Jing and couldn't step forward at all!
He wanted to break free from Su Jing, but he was injured beforeIt was too heavy, and Su Jing had learned some weird tricks from nowhere, and he actually restrained Jiang Feng in place!
"Ah... it's coming... it's coming... it's finally coming..."
In the distance, the excitement in Yao Yue's eyes was beyond words. She suddenly shivered, a strange blush appeared on her face, and her legs tightened unconsciously...
Seeing that such a beautiful scene was about to happen in front of her, she had been looking forward to it for five days and suppressing it for five days. At this moment, she actually released herself for the first time in her life!
"Suffer death, you bitch!!!"
Yan Nantian roared angrily, and he looked like a tiger descending from the mountain!
He raised his palms and rushed towards Huayue Nu who was struggling to stand up!
"Feng Lang... at least, your life has been saved! I just wish I couldn't help you give birth to a child..."
